id: title:adboio:report task usage before compute rates take effect

review.posthog_relevance: Billing and pricing tier enforcement, specifically preventing cost calculation before a pricing rule becomes active.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1 implement a guard returning zero cost if the current time precedes the rate card's effective date, while P1.F1.H2 refactors the dependency from a potentially unreliable index access to a named variable `pricing_start`. P1.F2.H1 adds a corresponding test. This demonstrates a substantive, bounded correctness improvement for billing reliability, though,
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation or the full context of the rate card initialization, so the exact mechanism of `pricing_start` and the broader billing system dependency cannot be fully verified. No unverified outcomes are inferred.
